description: Horizontal strip of a top-down pixel art fantasy world map: the far northern frontier. Continue the reference terrain northward into a remote wind-streaked polar snowfield with a glacier shelf edge, wind-cut drifts and one or two isolated frost-covered rock outcrops. Mostly empty authored snow, sparse and calm. No creatures, no buildings, no text, no borders.

reference_images.usage: below: the glacier and snowy forest immediately south of this strip; continue it northward
